definition.title: Cold-read your homepage
definition.description: Reads your public homepage the way a stranger would and reports, with quoted evidence, whether it answers what this is, who it's for, what to do next, and what it costs or how to start.

product_url.title: Homepage URL
product_url.description: The public page a first-time visitor lands on.

additional_pages.title: Pricing or about page (optional)
additional_pages.description: Up to two more public pages a first-time visitor would click to, such as pricing or about. Leave empty to read only the homepage.

notes.title: Context for the reader (optional)
notes.description: Anything a stranger wouldn't know that changes what counts as a fair answer, for example that pricing is sales-only.
